title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Chokka Thangam warmly welcomes Anbu's family as they reach their ancestral home and reminisce about its past. He plots to frighten them into abandoning plans to sell the house.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kalamma stops Paraman and Ilamathi from leaving and apologises to Ilamathi. Later, Ranjitham overhears Ilamathi planning a DNA test for Paraman and Viji.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri explains the costing of the project, wins praise and misses Sudar's call. Learning from Shanmugam that Sudar and Abinaya fled, Vetri joins a frantic search for them.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Poongodi warns Rasathi not to meddle between her and Manjamalai. Ilavarasi tries to pour turmeric water on Azhagar, but he escapes, prompting Poongodi to take up the challenge.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Ragavan orders Lakshmi to watch Shruthi, while Malar rages at Bagyaraj. Facing Ragavan's questions later, Malar blames his family for her mother's injury and confronts Shruthi.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Shattered by the cancelled wedding, Saravanan angrily confronts Pandian over his stubborn refusal. Later, Thangamayil breaks down before Meena as family tensions escalate.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila teases Nadesan over Chandayatha's snacks. While walking, Cheran and Chandayatha spot Karthika. Chozhan teasingly asks Nila to fast for him, sparking a happy moment.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Meena grows anxious after learning that Sathya has moved Chandra to the new flat without informing her. Shruthi's parents invite Annamalai's family to their new business opening.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Sethupathi is shocked to learn villagers develop eye problems after his free eye care camp. Tamizhselvi grows tense as Vellathai, Perumatha and other villagers are hospitalised.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Kasthuri criticises Karikalan's lack of care towards Saranya, making him regretful and speak to her kindly. Meanwhile, Pooja urges Aadhavan to reveal their love to his family.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: After learning that Shanmugam is not wealthy, Azhagappan sends his men to attack Kandhasamy's mess. Enraged, Kandhasamy confronts Shanmugam over his love for Abhi.

title: Bigg Boss
description: Raghav and Muthazhagi end in tears, while a block-grabbing fairness debate divides the house. As few get eliminated from the task, Jason's comment on Avinash triggers a fight.
